summary: Completed comprehensive testing of African food boxes catalog. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success), but found critical frontend filtering bug.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 520 error when fetching all recipes
minor_bugs.impact: Recipes page may not load properly

data_issues.issue: Box data duplication during multiple seed operations
data_issues.impact: Causes duplicate boxes in catalog (22 instead of 11)
data_issues.solution: Fixed by re-seeding data - seed endpoint should clear existing data first

critical_bugs.issue: Country filtering not working - shows all boxes regardless of selected country
critical_bugs.details: Backend API filtering works correctly (Gabon: 2 boxes, Cameroun: 3 boxes), but frontend doesn't update display when filter changes

ui_bugs.issue: React key duplication errors in console
ui_bugs.details: Console shows 'Encountered two children with the same key' errors for all box IDs

passed_tests: All specific African boxes exist (Nyembwe, Ndolé, Poulet DG, Koki, Garba, etc.)
Box detail pages show exactly 4 dishes each
Highlights and nutritional values displayed properly
Backend country filtering API works perfectly
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix frontend country filtering integration. Backend API works correctly but frontend doesn't update when country filter changes. Check useEffect dependencies and state management in CataloguePage.jsx. Also fix React key duplication warnings.
